plants.name: huckleberry-foreground
plants.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE isolated foreground huckleberry shrub game asset with true transparent RGBA background. Reference image is STYLE AND BOTANICAL FAMILY only, not a background to reproduce. Match its rounded huckleberry foliage, painterly 2D children's storybook world. A low broad asymmetrical shrub, branching naturally outward from one connected rooted base, 3 unequal lobes, rounded oval leaves with softly pointed ends, broad matte painted green value bands, aqua shaded undersides, dark teal contours. Sparse purple berries in just two small subordinate clusters. Larger quieter leaves with only one subtle vein, NOT a radial rosette, not glossy wax, not hundreds of tiny repetitive leaves. Width about twice height. Soft upper-left sunlight, no white specular dots. Plenty of transparent margin all sides, complete clean silhouette including base, no soil mound, no grass, no rocks, no ground shadow, no flowers, no scenery, no checkerboard. Designed to be partially cropped at a scene corner and swayed gently as a single plant, grounded perspective matching reference.

plants.name: huckleberry-companion
plants.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE isolated compact huckleberry shrub with true transparent RGBA background. Reference scene is botanical and painted style reference ONLY. A graceful low offset grouping of three connected branching leafy sprays with rounded small oval leaves, an asymmetrical dome with one taller left shoulder and a lower right taper. SAME botanical family as the rounded huckleberry shrubs behind the flowers in reference scene. Rounded ovals, spring green broad painted highlight bands, blue teal leaf undersides and restrained dark contours, matte soft 2D storybook illustration, upper-left sunlight. Just one sparse cluster of three small muted purple berries nestled among foliage. No circular rosette, no ornamental flower heads, no unrelated long strap leaves, no glossy plastic rendering. Width 2.3 times height. Complete plant at one root base, transparent gaps, full silhouette surrounded by transparent margin, NO ground grass soil rocks shadow scenery or checkerboard. This is a quieter middle-distance companion to a larger foreground huckleberry, with fewer finer leaf details and soft visual contrast.

plants.name: cream-bellflower
plants.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One isolated small cream bellflower plant for a polished 2D storybook garden, true transparent RGBA background. Reference image provides painted style and upper-left lighting ONLY. Botanically coherent plant: TWO fine gently arching green stems, three drooping warm ivory bell blooms total, attached visibly to stems arising from a compact cluster of five broad softly pointed basal leaves. One small unopened bud. Asymmetrical graceful silhouette leaning slightly left, clearly legible stem connections and rooted base. Leaf family appropriate to bellflowers, not a berry shrub. Matte broad green painted bands and cool aqua shadows, restrained dark teal contour, no shiny plastic. Keep blooms understated, cream not bright pure white, small compared with foliage. Complete freestanding plant with ample transparent margins. No other plants, no purple berries, no hydrangea, no grass, no soil, no rocks, no shadow, no background or checkerboard.

plates.prompt: Precise scene edit for reversible layered game art. Keep exactly the same path outline, every paving stone, huge left conifer, pool and rope posts, mountains, clouds, sky, viewpoint and framing. No new plants or flowers, no redesign. Match original painting seamlessly. Return entire original square scene.
